chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: George Gershwin and the production team
summary: Gershwin left staging to others; the only conflict was DuBose Heyward wanting the lyrics heard and Gershwin wanting the music.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: George Gershwin, you knew him personally?
Can you tell me a little bit --

The only thing I can tell you about him is he's a fine fella, I didn't have no association only this theater. He was a fine fellow. Him and his brother both. Alexander Smallens wasn't bad, neither was Rubin (inaudible). They were all nice people. I loved to do with them.
What sort of role did George Gershwin play in the show aside

No, nothing. Didn't do nothing. He left it to them. They did it. (Inaudible) staged the show. Alexander Smallens conducted the show. The only difficulty they had is DuBose Heyward wanted the lyrics to be heard and he wanted the music soft and Gershwin wanted the music to be heard, so that's sort of a confliction they had but they come out all right. Everything smoothed down nicely.
